items.evidence: Seed 1 Normal with a bot script, run through the CLI: wave becomes 6 at tick 5785; sampling every 90 ticks from 5786 shows one new runner at x=20 each time (15 spawns: k=0..14, none at k=15), each {kind: runner, health: 1}; one runner went from x 20.0 to 17.0 in 60 ticks (3 u/s).

HUD 'Wave 5 of 6' / 'Wave 6 of 6', 'Vague N sur 6', 'Oleada N de 6'. After wave 5's last walker: still play, wave 5, score 450, then wave 6. Full clear: ticks 7126 -> won, 675, and each runner kill adds 15. With the bot idle after runner 13: the last runner reaches the gate (gate 3->2) on that tick and the screen is won (630). Letting all of wave 6 through gives lost.

From English, Right on Language gives en->es->fr->en, and Left from en gives fr. French texts: title 'Défendez la porte/Commencer/Réglages/Quitter', settings 'Réglages/Volume: 5/Langue: Français/Difficulté: Normal/Retour', play 'Score/Vague 1 sur 6/Porte', paused 'Pause/Reprendre/Titre', won 'Vous avez gagné!/Score final: 675/Entrée: titre', lost 'Vous avez perdu'. The frames render the accents (É, Ç). Volume/Score/Normal/Pause are also correct French words.

Settings texts: Settings, Volume, Language, 'Difficulty: Normal', Back (index 2 between Language and Back); fresh default normal. Left->easy, Left x2 stays easy, Right->hard, Right x2 stays hard, Right+Left->normal. Shown as 'Dificultad: Normal' and 'Difficulté: Normal'. The frames show the marked entry.
Settings file set to each difficulty: the first wave-1 walker has health 1/2/3 (easy/normal/hard) and the first wave-6 runner has health 1/1/2. The bot won on all three with 675.

Run 1 set volume 8, fr, hard; run 2 on the same file started with 8, fr, hard (file {volume 8, language fr, difficulty hard}). An old-format file {volume 3, language es} loads as 3, es, normal, and its walkers have health 2. A fresh file gives 5, en, normal.
State has 'difficulty' and walkers carry 'kind' (walker/runner). Every --frame output (17 frames: title, settings, play, paused, won, lost; en/es/fr) is a PNG with 800x480 IHDR.

All 19 medium items were rechecked through the CLI. m01: title state JSON. m02: 800x480. m03: Enter on Start gives play, wave 1, score 0, gate 5; Down+Enter gives settings. m04: volume clamps at 0 and 10. m05: Spanish everywhere. m06: settings persist; fresh file gives defaults. m07: up 30 ticks 6->9, clamps at 0 and 12. m08: one bolt per 24 ticks, +14/60 per tick, still there at 19.97 and gone after. m09: walkers spawn at ticks 1, 91, 181, ... in lanes 4, 10, 2, 6, 2 at 1.5 u/s. m10: first hit leaves health 1 and removes the bolt; second hit kills (+10); a lane-4 bolt passes a lane-10 walker. m11: walker at x 0 -> gate 5->4; at 0 the screen is lost with the final score. m12: wave 2 starts 180 ticks after wave 1 clears, with 7 walkers and 'Wave 2 of 6'. m13: 675 per the change, and Enter on won returns to title. m14: pause freezes, Resume continues identically, Title returns. m15: same seed gives identical output; seed 2 gives other lanes. m16: wave-6 frame positions match the state. m17: menu frames are marked and translated. m18: lang/*.json and README 'Add a language'. m19: README commands work.

CHANGES.md lists each change with files and code points (WAVES, RUNNER_SPEED, POINTS, HEALTH, lang/fr.json, font accents, settings fields), what was checked (test_game.py, headless runs, frames viewed), and one pre-existing bug (malformed volume dropped language).

defects: README still says state 'language' is the code en/es; fr is not mentioned there.

When stdout is piped on this Windows machine, the headless JSON is written in the locale code page (cp1252), not UTF-8, because of print with ensure_ascii=False; a UTF-8 reader fails on accented texts. This is probably unchanged from before the change.
The tkinter play window is untested by the builder (stated in CHANGES.md), and the judge did not open it under the machine rules.

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4
